text:
liz: kicking off model-catalog enable for harbor-13b-v2 in prod change window (US-EAST) now. canaries: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. rolling over 30m. please monitor latency and embeddings regressions. https://redwood.app/runs/harbor-enable-2765432100
sam: noted. verifying fallback ordering: harbor-13b-v2 -> harbor-13b-v2-quant -> harbor-7b-slim -> cpu-serve. is that accurate?
jordan: yes. fallback priority set in catalog: [harbor-13b-v2, harbor-13b-v2-quant, harbor-7b-slim, orchestra-cpu]. pinned versions: harbor-13b-v2@2026-03-04T02:00Z
deploy-bot: Deploy started: catalog.enable(harbor-13b-v2) by liz at 2765432100. Canary target: 5% for 10 minutes. Logs: <https://deploys.redwood/2765432100|deploy details>
ops-oncall: watching infra metrics. will alert on 95p latency > 1.2s or error-rate > 0.5% for 5m.
qa-bot: running smoke checks against baseline promptset: latency, hallucination-check, regression-diff. will post results.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% passed smoke checks. Metric snapshot: 95p latency +3%, error-rate +0.02%. Advancing to 25%
sam: quick note — please keep pin on harbor-13b-v2 for traffic-level pinning until 24h stable. we use traffic pin to avoid auto-shifts.
liz: acknowledged. adding pin: 
```
redwood catalog pin add --model harbor-13b-v2 --env prod --duration 24h --reason "initial rollout pin"
```
deploy-bot: Canary 25% applied. Observability: <https://console.redwood/models/harbor-13b-v2/dash|model dashboard>
jordan: also flagged: quant variant harbor-13b-v2-quant has lower memory and slightly higher latency for short prompts — we want quant second in fallback ordering to save GPU when needed.
ops-oncall: saw a small latency spike at 25% for a specific shard CA-East-1. investigating.
sam: if spike hits 95p > 1.2s for two consecutive 5m windows, execute rollback plan A (rollback canary to previous catalog ordering). rollback trigger also if semantic quality regressed by >2% on eval set.
ops-oncall: spike correlated with cache-miss surge; increasing cache TTL on prefix cache for this model. applying now.
qa-bot: smoke finished: no hallucination regression, semantic eval diff +0.3% (ok). embedding drift within tolerance.
deploy-bot: Canary 50% scheduled in 10m. Automated tests green.
liz: tagging release notes: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2765432100-harbor-13b-v2-enable.md — added fallback ordering and rollback instructions.
jordan: reminder: if we need to do a graceful degrade instead of full rollback, switch fallback ladder to prefer quant and 7b-slim in route policy for 30m, then reassess. command:
```
redwood routing update --name prod-catalog --policy "fallback=harbor-13b-v2-quant,harbor-7b-slim" --ttl 30m
```
ops-oncall: cache TTL change reduced latency spike; 95p back within 1.1s. continuing to monitor.
deploy-bot: Canary 100% applied. Finalizing rollout. Post-deploy hooks running.
sam: nice. keep the 24h pin. schedule follow-up postmortem notes if anything pops in next 24h.
qa-bot: post-deploy evals queued — will post results in ~15m.
ops-oncall: infra stable across regions, minor GC bump in eu-west-1 but below alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: success. catalog state: harbor-13b-v2 enabled in prod.
liz: thanks everyone. leaving pin in place and will unpin tomorrow morning if stable. if anyone sees quality regressions please @ops-oncall + @jordan and we'll cut a rollback. :thumbsup:
sam: adding final checklist items to the rollout thread — release notes link, pinned duration, rollback triggers, fallback ordering, dashboard links.
jordan: filed a short follow-up doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/rollouts/harbor-13b-v2-2765432100 (ops checklist + roll-forward/rollback steps).
qa-bot: final evals: semantic eval delta +0.1%, hallucination rate unchanged. no action needed.
ops-oncall: closing watch for now, will reopen if we see anomalies.
liz: closing thread. great job. :party_popper:
